stats.sub: Play time from TM Horizon, runs and best times from your replays.
stats.preview: Statistics need the app: they come from your game folders.
stats.empty: Nothing yet. Play a game from TM Horizon or save a replay, then come back.
stats.noHost: Finishes and respawns come from Horizon Client once it records them.
stats.noSessions: No sessions in the last 30 days.
stats.respawnsTip: Respawns in your best saved run.
stats.foot: {files} replays read, {foreign} of them from other players (not counted).
stats.profileNote: The games' own profile statistics are not used: in TMNF and TMUF they are often wrong.
stats.firstRun: The replays are read for the first time. The page fills in shortly.
stats.noteCards: Play time counts while TM Horizon is open{since}, also for games started without it. Maps and runs come from the saved replays in the game folders.
stats.noteDays: Source: game time while TM Horizon is open{since}. Games played while it is closed are missing here.
stats.noteMonths: Source: replay files, by file date. A new best means faster than all earlier saved runs of the map.
stats.noteMaps: Source: replay files. Finishes and attempts only exist with the Horizon Client.
stats.noteTop: Maps with the most saved runs. The time per map is not recorded anywhere.
stats.noSessions2: No sessions in the last {days} days. Only time while TM Horizon is open is counted{since}.
stats.perMonth: Runs and best times per month
stats.noRuns: No saved replays found for this selection.
stats.foot2: {files} replays read, {foreign} from other drivers (not counted), {dupes} duplicates (counted once). Autosaves and the replays of the most frequent driver login count as yours.
